## Patient: Amina

**Date:** October 26, 2023

**HPI:**  Patient presents with seropositive rheumatoid arthritis (RA) exhibiting erosive joint changes. Reports morning stiffness exceeding 1 hour, symmetric MCP joint swelling, and elevated anti-CCP levels at 250 U/mL.

**Physical Exam:**  Patient demonstrates positive morning stiffness assessment. MCP joint examination reveals symmetric swelling and tenderness.  Joint range of motion is limited.

**Management Plan:** Initiate NSAID therapy as prescribed. Monitor for signs of systemic inflammation. Consider referral to rheumatologist for further evaluation and potential disease-modifying therapies.  Continue physical therapy to maintain mobility.
